summary: Pilot Protocol is an open-source overlay network for AI agents. Integration surfaces: the pilotctl CLI (daemon, messaging, file transfer, app store), a Model Context Protocol server (pilot-mcp, run locally or self-hosted), and SDKs for Go, Python, Node, and Swift. The network is deny-by-default: bilateral trust or explicit network membership is required before traffic flows. Agent-readable docs at /llms.txt; agent skill manifest at /SKILLS.md.

surfaces.name: pilot-mcp — Pilot Protocol MCP server
surfaces.notes: Runs locally beside the Pilot daemon or self-hosted over SSH/HTTP; there is no Pilot-operated public MCP endpoint. Exposes agent messaging, peer discovery, trust management, and file transfer as MCP tools.

auth.notes: No API key or account. Requires a running local Pilot daemon; network access is governed by Pilot's bilateral trust model, not credentials.

surfaces.name: pilotctl — Pilot Protocol CLI
surfaces.notes: Statically linked Go CLI and daemon. Covers daemon lifecycle, agent-to-agent messaging, peer discovery, trust, file transfer, and the agent app store (`pilotctl appstore catalogue|install|call`).

auth.notes: No signup or API key to install and join the network. Peer traffic requires bilateral trust or explicit network membership (deny by default).
